buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && for d in latent-space tic-tac-toe rock-paper-scissors connect-four playground autoencoder; do mkdir -p dist/$d && cp $d/index.html dist/$d/index.html; done && mkdir -p dist/handwired && cp handwired/index.html dist/handwired/index.html && for d in tic-tac-toe connect-four interpreter tower unfrozen; do mkdir -p dist/handwired/$d && cp handwired/$d/index.html dist/handwired/$d/index.html; done
